sections.title: Amsterdam at 750: Exploring Culture, Society, and Policy in the Dutch Capital
sections.description: Join us on an immersive journey through the vibrant city of Amsterdam as it celebrates its 750th anniversary. This seminar will delve into the rich tapestry of Dutch culture, society, and policy, offering a unique perspective guided by a native Dutch academic (who celebrated Amsterdam’s 700th in 1975!). Through a series of virtual trips, classroom discussions, readings, and multimedia resources, participants will gain an understanding of Amsterdam's past, present, and future.
